title: CRI: Measurement-Driven Control Readiness Index (EC-CRI and DC-CRI)
description:
Research software, simulation models, recorded datasets, and reproducible notebooks for the measurement-driven Control Readiness Index (CRI): a plant-agnostic supervisory layer that decides online, from input-output data, operational limits, and measurement quality alone, whether an adaptive, learning-based, or optimization-driven controller should be given authority over a plant, and otherwise keeps a fallback controller in charge.

The package provides Engineering-Configured CRI (EC-CRI); Data-Calibrated CRI (DC-CRI) with risk-constrained calibration of indicator weights and decision thresholds and leave-one-scenario-out (LOSO) evaluation; a comparative benchmark against Simplex runtime assurance and a discrete-time control-barrier-function safety filter; and a Measurement Validity Gate with fault-injection and recovery tests. The framework is demonstrated and validated on a converter-dominated hybrid AC/DC microgrid case study, and its interfaces allow it to be applied to other controllers, plants, and hardware-in-the-loop or experimental targets in industrial cyber-physical systems.
